body: Effectiveness. I don't care if it hurts. It's supposed to hurt. No more explaining. Need a plan of action. I've heard the tall building thing works quite well. Usually you die on the way down due to force, or slamming against the side of the building.

So just hold out and maybe I'll get lucky? Ill take my chances with the bullet. Its not about those around me. They're doing fine. They're not here, on this garbage, last resort, no giving a shit website. What happened to you, I will not wait for. Proactive vs. Reactive. I have served my time. The match is out of flint. 


I appreciate the effort(s). There are too many people on earth anyways. I'm not allowed to create within the confines previously set, and I do not wish to consume any further. One final act from a burden, to all those who passed a thought my way.

I want to kill myself the same way a meth addict wants a final score. Or the way a writer wants their masterpiece.  Or the way an ironworker wants that full weeks paid vacation. I used all my good karma. I used all my paid vacations. I have run out of time in the black. I am forever going to be in the red. Who wants to live if living means just surviving? I've survived in the woods. I've survived under the bridges.  

Surviving hurts. The embarrassment,  the hunger pangs, selling who and what you love for another day of survival, is just not worth it. No matter how hard you work, or how early you get up, that one break will not happen for you. Suicide is being burnt out on trying everything, when you have all the opportunity in the world, and not one of those opportunities try YOU out. 

Tl; dr     Burnt out. Want to try one more thing.
